word_definition: whitespace tokens of the caption (`caption.split()`), as in the dataset and completion reports.
limitations: Words are whitespace tokens, so punctuation attached to a word is not counted separately and the JSON keys of the 21 malformed GPT captions count as words; the valid-for-all sample excludes those recordings.
Model captions are scored against five references (E12) and held-out human captions against four (E13), so model and human correlations come from different reference sets.

Correlations are associations over recordings, not effects of length: length varies with the recording and the content of the caption. Formal tests and corrections for multiple comparisons belong to E16.
CIs are 95% percentile intervals per comparison, uncorrected.
